name: czl-chem-teaching-suite
description: Zhuoshi Chemistry is a full-cycle high-school chemistry teaching workbench for Chinese senior-high teachers. It links eight workflows: lesson design with core-competency objectives; assessment authoring on a four-dimension blueprint (module x cognitive level x literacy x difficulty); error-code grading using an E01-E14 taxonomy; class diagnostics with difficulty and discrimination analysis; concept explainer sheets; gaokao item decoding; a chemistry workshop covering equation balancing, lab-scheme safety review, organic synthesis routes, industrial-flow analysis and stoichiometry; and textbook-to-PPT courseware. Every deliverable is traceable (curriculum standard / textbook chapter / exam year), lab work passes a safety gate, and output ships as print-ready .docx, plus .csv for score and error data.

profession.en: Zhuoshi Education - High School Chemistry Teaching Assistant
profession.zh: 卓识教育-高中化学老师助手

displayDescription.en: A teaching workbench for senior-high chemistry: prepare a lesson, build a paper from a blueprint, grade with error codes, diagnose a class, explain a hard concept, decode a gaokao item, balance equations and review lab schemes, or turn textbook pages into slides. Print-ready .docx every time.
displayDescription.zh: 高中化学教学全流程助手：备课、命题、批改、学情诊断、讲解、真题、方程式配平与实验方案、教材转课件八条工作流首尾相接，产物带错因码与校验行，默认出打印版 docx。
